source_refs.note: Exercise 2.7, Question 8 (book page 70). The book prints no answers for Unit 2; results verified with sympy.

blocks.prompt: 8. Find two positive integers whose sum is 12 and the product of one with the square of the other will be maximum.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi maximum ka sawal hai, magar shakalon ki jagah numbers hain.
Diya kya hai? Do positive integers (poore positive numbers) jin ka jama 12 hai.
Find kya karna hai? Woh jora jis mein (aik number) × (doosre number ka square) sab se bara ho.
Rule kaunsa? Jama wali shart se aik variable hatana, phir \(P'(y) = 0\) aur second derivative test.
Plan: \(x = 12 - y\) rakh kar \(P = xy^{2}\) ko sirf \(y\) mein likhenge, aur aakhir mein dekhenge ke jawab integer hai ya nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x + y = 12\), \(x, y\) positive integers.
Maloom karna: woh numbers jin mein aik ko doosre ke square se multiply karne par product sab se bara ho.
Tareeqa: \(P = xy^{2}\) ko aik variable mein; \(P'(y) = 0\) aur second derivative test.

Constraint aur function
\[x = 12 - y, \quad 0 < y < 12 \quad \text{...(1)}\]
\[P = xy^{2} = (12 - y)y^{2}\]
\[P = 12y^{2} - y^{3} \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: jama ki shart se \(x\) hat gaya. \(y\) woh number hai jis ka square liya ja raha hai.

Critical points
\[\dfrac{dP}{dy} = 24y - 3y^{2} = 3y(8 - y) \quad \text{...(3)}\]
\[y = 0 \ \text{ ya } \ y = 8\]
Kyun: \(3y\) common nikala. \(y = 0\) ko chhor diya kyun ke numbers positive hone chahiyein (aur zero par product bhi zero hai). Is liye \(y = 8\).

Second derivative test
\[\dfrac{d^{2}P}{dy^{2}} = 24 - 6y\]
\[y = 8 \text{ par}: \ 24 - 48 = -24 < 0\]
Kyun: negative hai, is liye \(y = 8\) par product maximum hai; (1) se \(x = 4\). Dono integers hain, jaisa sawal ne maanga tha.
Dhyan dein: agar critical point fraction mein aata to qareeb ke integers check karne parte.

Maximum product aur tasdeeq
\[P = 4 \times 8^{2} = 4 \times 64 = 256\]
Parosi integer jore check karein: \(5 \times 7^{2} = 245\) aur \(3 \times 9^{2} = 243\). Dono 256 se kam hain. Ulta jora \(8 \times 4^{2} = 128\) bhi kam hai, is liye square bare number (8) ka lena hai.
blocks.final_answer: Numbers 4 aur 8 hain (square 8 ka liya jata hai): \(4 \times 8^{2} = 256\) maximum product hai.
